title: Leakage precision on realization decisions and a context's own subject
situation: The first leakage run over the whole design (2026-10-10) warned 69 times: none on concepts, 55 on decisions, 14 on examples. Nearly all are legitimate by the design: realization decisions name tools on purpose (0031), and delivery's examples name omp, the harness its own subject names. A warning list that is mostly expected noise will be ignored.
decision: Leakage warns only where realization replaces meaning: a decision states whether it constrains realization, and one that does is not warned for naming what it constrains; the words a context's own subject names count as that context's own words.
consequences: Belongs to the execution cut (0055) or a small follow-up; until then the warnings are read with this in mind.
